import xapi from 'xapi';

async function buildWallpaperUI() {

  const prettyNameMap = {
    arcticnight: "Arctic Night",
    carbonblack: "Carbon Black",
    chiliplum: "Chili Plum",
    crystalmist: "Crystal Myst",
    eveningfjord: "Evening Fjord ✪",
    firstlight: "First Light",
    foggymoor: "Foggy Moor",
    meadowstone: "Meadow Stone",
    pebbleshoal: "Pebble Shoal",
    poppybreeze: "Poppy Breeze",
    sandshoal: "Sandy Shoal",
    smokedrose: "Smoked Rose"
  }

  let optionXML = ``

  const wallPapers = (await xapi.Command.UserInterface.WallpaperBundle.List()).Bundle;
  console.log(wallPapers);
  wallPapers.forEach(paper => {
    optionXML += `<Value><Key>${paper.Name}</Key><Name>${prettyNameMap[paper.Name] ? prettyNameMap[paper.Name] : paper.Name}</Name></Value>`
  })

  let fullXml = `<Extensions>
  <Panel>
    <Order>9999</Order>
    <Location>ControlPanel</Location>
    <Icon>Tv</Icon>
    <Name>RoomOS26 Wallpaper List</Name>
    <ActivityType>Custom</ActivityType>
    <Page>
      <Name>OS26 Wallpaper List</Name>
      <Row>
        <Name>Row</Name>
        <Widget>
          <WidgetId>os26_wallPaper~Names</WidgetId>
          <Type>GroupButton</Type>
          <Options>size=4;columns=2</Options>
          <ValueSpace>
            ${optionXML}
          </ValueSpace>
        </Widget>
      </Row>
      <PageId>os26_wallPaper</PageId>
      <Options>hideRowNames=1</Options>
    </Page>
  </Panel>
</Extensions>`

  await xapi.Command.UserInterface.Extensions.Panel.Save({ PanelId: 'os26_wallPaper' }, fullXml)
}

function delay(ms) { return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms)) }

async function init() {
  await buildWallpaperUI();

  xapi.Event.UserInterface.Extensions.Widget.Action.on(async ({ WidgetId, Type, Value }) => {
    if (Type == 'released' && WidgetId == 'os26_wallPaper~Names') {
      await xapi.Command.UserInterface.WallpaperBundle.Set({ Name: Value });
      await delay(350);
      await xapi.Command.UserInterface.Extensions.Widget.UnsetValue({ WidgetId: 'os26_wallPaper~Names' })
    }
  });
}

init()
